accession_source: not named in the paper (S5.4.p1 says all data are in the paper/supplement); matched to the paper by content (tissue, diet, genotypes, RSEM + limma TMM pipeline, CPM>=1 in >=3 samples filter)
sample_inclusion: gastrocnemius of mice fed HFD for 6 weeks, fasted overnight; RIN > 8; each library = pool of two animals (S4.22.p1); 3 libraries per genotype
exercise_factor: none in the sequenced samples: all mice sedentary HFD-fed and fasted overnight (FIG5 A-C, S4.22.p1). Exercise appears only in non-sequencing experiments (treadmill IL-15 plasma ELISA, FIG5E; human biopsies, FIG1A; wheel/treadmill behaviour, FIG4)
primary_estimand: genotype effect (muscle p38alpha or p38alpha/gamma knockout vs control) on gastrocnemius expression in sedentary HFD-fed mice; not an exercise effect
planned_contrasts: p38alphaMCK-KO vs control (S4.22.p2; paper: 15 secreted-protein DEGs at raw P < 0.05, S2.7.p1/S4.24.p1; total DEG count at FDR not reported)
p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO vs control (S4.22.p2; count not reported)
p38alphaMCK-KO vs p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO (S4.22.p2; count not reported)
normalization: TMM (limma pipeline), genes with CPM >= 1 in >= 3 samples (S4.22.p2)
paper_method: limma on RSEM expected counts, TMM normalization (S4.22.p2)
paper_results: Il15 up in p38alphaMCK-KO but not in p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO vs control (S2.7.p1, FIG5C); 15 secreted-protein DEGs in p38alphaMCK-KO
